```{r}
#| paged.print: false
tidy4a <- table4a %>% 
  mutate(
    `1999` = as.character(`1999`),
    `2000` = as.character(`2000`),
  ) |> 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = country:`2000`,
    names_to = "year", 
    values_to = "cases")
tidy4a
```
